name: Lunastia Astyr
original_name: ルナスティア・アスティール
source: Daughter of a royal family of succubi. Due to her condition she spent most of her childhood secluded in her room, therefore she doesn't know much about outside world. Thanks to her bloodline she posseses immense magical power.
